narr: A cold front dropped down from the north, causing showers and thunderstorms to develop. The storm motion was nearly parallel to the boundary, causing some storms to train over the same area. This led to instances of flooding and flash flooding.
ev: There was a rapid rise along the Rock Creek of several feet within an hour. The water level crested at 9.12 feet at 12:15 AM EST. The water level did not fall below flood stage until 8:45 AM on the 3rd of July. ||Water reached several portions of the Valley Trail between picnic areas 7 and 10 in Rock Creek Park.
Numerous vehicles were stranded in high water. Rock Creek was flowing over Beach Drive Northwest between Porter Street and Piney Branch Parkway Northwest.
